recognize_zh: 這不是型態圖，而是血球計數儀的直方圖與散布圖：DIFF 散布圖中嗜中性球群（青綠色）明顯為最大族群，淋巴球群相對很少；WNB 圖也以白血球主群為主，符合嗜中性球增多。它提示需要推片複查，但本身無法區分真性或假性 Pelger-Huët。
features: RBC histogram: single unimodal peak centered near 80–90 fL within the discriminators
PLT histogram: peak around 5–10 fL with a tail that does not return to baseline toward the upper discriminator (possible large platelets or interference)
DIFF scattergram (SS vs FL): dominant, dense neutrophil cluster (cyan) with a small monocyte cluster (green) and very few lymphocytes/eosinophils
WNB scattergram: one dominant WBC cluster with a separate low ghost/debris cloud
No distinct abnormal cluster (e.g., blast or atypical lymphocyte region) is evident at this resolution
describe_en: This figure is a hematology analyzer display (RBC and PLT histograms with DIFF and WNB scattergrams), not a morphologic image. The RBC histogram is unimodal and normocytic. The PLT histogram fails to return to baseline at the upper end, which may reflect large platelets or interference and warrants smear review. The DIFF scattergram is dominated by a dense neutrophil cluster with relatively few lymphocytes and a small monocyte population, supporting neutrophilia. The analyzer cannot assess nuclear segmentation, so the smear review showing bilobed neutrophils is what identified the pseudo-Pelger-Huët change in this reactive leukocytosis.
